chapter.heading: Joy in the Fellowship of GodA Psalm of David when he was in the wilderness of Judah.
chapter.v:
O God,
You are my God;Early will I seek You;My soul thirsts for You;My flesh longs for YouIn a dry and thirsty landWhere there is no water. [2 Kin. 3:4] [Deut. 2:9; Num. 21:28 c Is. 15:1–16:14; Jer. Amos 2:1-3; Zeph.]

So I
have looked for You in the sanctuary,To see Your power and Your glory. [Lev. 21:5; Jer. 48:37]

Because Your
lovingkindness is better than life,My lips shall praise You. [Jer. 48:38]

Thus I
will bless You while I live;I will lift up my hands in Your name. [Num. 21:28; 32:3; Jer. 48:34 3 So]

My soul
shall be satisfied as with marrow and fatness,And my mouth shall praise You with joyful lips. [Is. 16:11; Jer. 48:31 h Jer. Jer. 48:34]

When I
remember You on my bed,I meditate on You in the night watches. [Num. 32:36]

Because You
have been my help,Therefore in the shadow of Your wings I will rejoice.

My soul
follows close behind You;Your right hand upholds me.

But those
who seek my life, to destroy it,Shall go into the lower parts of the earth. [2 Kin. 17:25; Jer. 50:17 5 So]

They shall
fall by the sword;They shall be a portion for jackals.

But the
king shall rejoice in God;Everyone who swears by Him shall glory;But the mouth of those who speak lies shall be stopped.
